args.question: What is the cardholder statement on this transaction?

args.narrative: The transaction was authorised on 2026-03-06 for USD 35.94 (auth code 312090, approved Y), and the receipt and capture are for the same USD 35.94.

args.explanation: Mastercard 4808 authorisation chargeback; cardholder said the amount is wrong. The authorisation record shows USD 35.94 approved on 2026-03-06, matching the receipt and the capture. I represented with both; the issuer accepted on 2026-04-09 and reversed the chargeback. Net cost is the USD 15 chargeback fee.
